snippet.title: Frenzy Freak Fantasy Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Frenzy Freak Fantasy is a bonkers strategy romp where you unleash fart-propelled T-Rexes, AK-47-toting toilet goblins, and crotch-cannon weirdos. Command wacko units, sling absurd attacks, and rule gut-busting battles in this nutty simulator.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3928560/Frenzy_Freak_Fantasy
